arxiv-1804-04497.title: Femtosecond photoexcitation dynamics inside a quantum solvent
arxiv-1804-04497.creator: Bernhard Thaler, Sascha Ranftl, Pascal Heim, Stefan Cesnik, Leonhard Treiber, Ralf Meyer, Andreas W. Hauser, Wolfgang E. Ernst, Markus Koch*
arxiv-1804-04497.description: Abstract Abstract The observation of chemical reactions on the time scale of the motion of electrons and nuclei has been made possible by lasers with ever shortened pulse lengths. Superfluid helium represents a special solvent that permits the synthesis of novel classes of molecules that have eluded dynamical studies so far.

arxiv-2111-02710.title: Towards dynamic multi-modal phenotyping using chest radiographs and physiological data
arxiv-2111-02710.creator: Nasir Hayat, Krzysztof J. Geras, Farah E. Shamout
arxiv-2111-02710.description: Abstract The healthcare domain is characterized by heterogeneous data modalities, such as imaging and physiological data. In practice, the variety of medical data assists clinicians in decision-making. However, most of the current state-of-the-art deep learning models solely rely upon carefully curated data of a single modality.

arxiv-2301-04656.title: Towards a population synthesis of discs and planets Thanks: Tables 3 and 4 are only available in electronic form at the CDS via anonymous ftp to cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr (130.79.128.5) or via https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/cgi-bin/qcat?J/A+A/ Affiliation: Universitäts-Sternwarte, Ludwig-Maximilians-Univ
arxiv-2301-04656.creator: Alexandre Emsenhuber, Remo Burn, Jesse Weder, Kristina Monsch, Giovanni Picogna, Barbara Ercolano, Thomas Preibisch
arxiv-2301-04656.description: Abstract Aims. We want to find the distribution of initial conditions that best reproduces disc observations at the population level. Methods. We first ran a parameter study using a 1D model that includes the viscous evolution of a gas disc, dust, and pebbles, coupled with an emission model to compute the millimetre flux observable with ALMA.

arxiv-2308-01885.title: On biharmonic functions on vector bundles
arxiv-2308-01885.creator: Mohamed Tahar Kadaoui Abbassi, Souhail Doua and Ibrahim Lakrini
arxiv-2308-01885.description: Abstract This paper is devoted to the investigation of harmonic and biharmonic functions on vector bundles equipped with spherically symmetric metrics. We will study the biharmonicity of vertical lifts of functions as well as r r -radial functions on vector bundle manifolds and, as a consequence, we will construct an infinite two-parameter family of proper biharmonic functions.

arxiv-2308-05302.title: Development of a low-background HPGe detector at Kamioka Observatory
arxiv-2308-05302.creator: K. Ichimura, H. Ikeda, Y. Kishimoto, M. Kurasawa, A.A. Suzuki, Y. Gando, M. Ikeda, K. Hosokawa, H. Sekiya, H. Ito, A. Minamino, S. Suzuki
arxiv-2308-05302.description: Abstract A new ultra-low background high-purity germanium (HPGe) detector has been installed at the Kamioka underground experimental site. The background count rate in the energy range from 40 keV to 2700 keV is about 25% lower than that of the first HPGe detector installed in 2016, which has the same detector specification and similar shielding geometry.

arxiv-2504-08772.title: Reward Generation via Large Vision-Language Model in Offline Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2504-08772.creator: Younghwan Lee †, Tung M. Luu †, Donghoon Lee, Chang D. Yoo
arxiv-2504-08772.description: Abstract In offline reinforcement learning (RL), learning from fixed datasets presents a promising solution for domains where real-time interaction with the environment is expensive or risky. However, designing dense reward signals for offline dataset requires significant human effort and domain expertise.

pmc-10532263.title: Outcomes in Patients with Acute Myocardial Infarction and Known Sleep Apnea: A Nationwide Analysis
pmc-10532263.creator: Claudio Rabec, Chan Sombrun, Sid Ahmed Bentounes, Marjolaine Georges, Arnaud Bisson, Florence Bichat, Alexandre Bodin, Julien Herbert, Marianne Zeller, Yves Cottin, Laurent Fauchier, Daniela Trabattoni, Bernward Lauer
pmc-10532263.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Sleep apnea (SA) is a common breathing disorder characterized by repetitive upper airway narrowing and closure. Although SA has been demonstrated to be an independent risk factor for all-cause mortality, the direct contribution of SA to worse cardiovascular prognosis may be difficult to evaluate, and its independent association with the different types of cardiovascular outcomes may be debated, particularly in the context of patients with acute myocardial infarction (AMI).

pmc-10831988.title: Prevalencia de estomatitis aftosa recurrente en un consultorio médico de familia, Manzanillo, Cuba. Un estudio transversal
pmc-10831988.creator: Viviana de la Caridad Collado Pérez, Milagros de la Caridad Pérez Suárez, Carlos Manuel Collado Hernández, Vivian Pérez Núñez
pmc-10831988.description: RESUMENIntroducción: La estomatitis aftosa recurrente, también conocida como úlceras aftosas o simplemente aftas, se considera la más común de las lesiones de la mucosa oral. Objetivo: Describir la prevalencia de la estomatitis aftosa recurrente. Método: Estudio descriptivo, transversal y prospectivo. Se evaluó a 847 pacientes que acudieron al Consultorio Médico de Familia N.

pmc-11453084.title: Impact of operative position on rotational alignment after intramedullary nailing of trochanteric fractures: a comparative analysis of lateral decubitus versus supine position
pmc-11453084.creator: Ahmet Yurteri, Numan Mercan, Mehmet Kılıç, Ahmet Temiz, Fatih Dogar, Duran Topak, Ahmet Yıldırım
pmc-11453084.description: BackgroundFixation of trochanteric fractures with an intramedullary nail in a non-physiological position can cause poor functional outcomes. The aim of this study is to evaluate the effect of intraoperative patient position on rotational alignment in intramedullary nail fixation of trochanteric fractures.MethodsThe femoral rotational alignment of 84 trochanteric fracture patients who underwent intramedullary nailing was measured by computed tomography (CT) images.

pmc-11474663.title: Implementation of a mixed-methods heat acclimation programme in a professional soccer referee before the 2022 FIFA world cup in Qatar: a case study
pmc-11474663.creator: Dale B Read, Daniel T Evans, Simon Breivik, Joshua D Elliott, Oliver R Gibson, Laurence P Birdsey
pmc-11474663.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectivesThis case study reports the real-world practicalities of implementing a mixed-methods heat acclimation (HA) programme before the 2022 FIFA World Cup.MethodsOne male English soccer referee (age: 44 years; height: 1.82 m; body mass: 76.0 kg) who had officiated professionally for over 17 years and had over 10 years’ experience officiating in European and international matches undertook an 11-session HA programme over 22 days.

pmc-12567850.title: Molecular Epidemiology of Hepatitis E Virus in Hungary (2018–2025): Emergence of Rare Subtypes and First Detection of HEV-4 in Central Europe
pmc-12567850.creator: Ágnes Dencs, Andrea Hettmann, Levente Zsichla, Viktor Müller, Anett Dömötör, Ágnes Barna-Lázár, Erzsébet Barcsay, Mária Takács, Mark Douglas
pmc-12567850.description: Hepatitis E virus (HEV) is an emerging cause of viral hepatitis in Europe, with increasing recognition in immunocompromised patients. While genotype 3 (HEV-3) is most prevalent in the region, molecular epidemiology data from Hungary have been limited. HEV strains from 118 RNA-positive patients diagnosed between 2018 and 2025 were genotyped. Next-generation sequencing yielded near-complete HEV genomes for 76 samples.

pmc-12846311.title: Patient Perspectives regarding Artificial Intelligence-Driven Trichoscopy for Alopecia Evaluation
pmc-12846311.creator: Caitlin A. Kearney, Anna L. Brinks, Carli N. Lawrence, Jerry Shapiro, Mario E. Lacouture, Kristen I. Lo Sicco
pmc-12846311.description: IntroductionAlopecia treatment can improve patients’ quality of life, but slow hair regrowth makes progress difficult to detect. Trichoscopic measurements (TMs; hair density, hairs/cm2; hair caliber, µm) provide an objective method for monitoring treatment response. Artificial intelligence (AI) enables trichoscopic analysis without hair clippings. This study examines the perspectives of alopecia patients regarding AI-driven trichoscopy.

pmc-13300195.title: Safety of epicardial access for ventricular tachycardia ablation using a micropuncture needle
pmc-13300195.creator: R Tilz, R Mamaev, S Popescu, C Eitel, K Ukita
pmc-13300195.description: BackgroundEpicardial access is often required for catheter ablation of ventricular tachycardia (VT) when arrhythmogenic substrates are located on the epicardial surface, but it carries a risk of serious complications such as cardiac tamponade and coronary artery injury. A refined technique using a small-caliber micropuncture needle (21-gauge) for percutaneous epicardial puncture may enhance safety by minimizing myocardial trauma.

pmc-13634461.title: Validation and comparison of two prearrest prediction scores for in-hospital cardiac arrest survival
pmc-13634461.creator: Hritul Karim, Eva Piscator, Gabriel Riva, Karl Oskar Ekvall, Kasper G. Lauridsen, Therese Djärv
pmc-13634461.description: BackgroundThe optimal pre-arrest prediction model for survival with favorable neurological outcomes following in-hospital cardiac arrest (IHCA) to aid Do-Not-Attempt-Cardiopulmonary-Resuscitation-decisions remains uncertain. This study aimed to externally validate the Prediction of Outcome for In-Hospital Cardiac Arrest (PIHCA) score and the Good Outcome Following Attempted Resuscitation (GO-FAR) 2 score and compare their performance for IHCA survival prediction.
